title: Ordinary and weighted importance sampling
brief: Estimate one policy's value from episodes that a different policy played, reweighting each return by how much likelier the target policy was to produce it, and compare the ordinary and weighted estimators.
hints: rho_{t:T-1} for every t at once is np.cumprod(step[::-1])[::-1], where step = pi[states, actions] / b[states, actions]. Put the target policy on top, not the behavior policy.
You only need rho_{0:T-1} and G_0 from each episode: importance_ratios(...)[0] and discounted_returns(...)[0].
OIS divides the sum of rho * G by the number of episodes. WIS divides it by the sum of rho, and returns 0.0 when every weight is zero.
